recipe.text: Fresh concept: a falchion (single broad forward-weighted blade) distinct from prior daggers/spears/scimitars. Generated via Cube generate_mesh, verified silhouette with one capture, persisted with save_mesh so it survives Play. Toolified with grip as Handle, placed in StarterPack. Fast-swing behavior (0.1/0.12/0.3) and short-reach moderate-damage hitbox (28 dmg, 6 studs, 0.3s server cooldown). Scoped build: no animation clips or extra systems.
